title.zh: UK signals end of 'light-touch' era with multi-agency raid on peer-to-peer crypto hubs
title.en: UK signals end of 'light-touch' era with multi-agency raid on peer-to-peer crypto hubs

current_state.zh: The UK's FCA, alongside tax authorities and the Metropolitan Police, shut down three illegal peer-to-peer crypto trading operations in London and issued detailed guidance to crypto firms ahead of the full regulatory framework taking effect in October 2027.
current_state.en: The UK's FCA, alongside tax authorities and the Metropolitan Police, shut down three illegal peer-to-peer crypto trading operations in London and issued detailed guidance to crypto firms ahead of the full regulatory framework taking effect in October 2027.
